json.reason: Classic React hook misuse: useEffect called with only a callback and no dependency array, so the effect re-runs on every render. Detectable purely from syntax (argument count).
json.title: useEffect without a dependency array
json.message: useEffect is called without a dependency array, so the effect runs after every render (here refetching data in a loop)
json.note: Passing only a callback to useEffect makes it re-run on every render, which causes repeated fetches and can loop forever when the effect sets state. Add a dependency array: `[]` to run once on mount, or list the values the effect actually depends on.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  any:
    - pattern: useEffect($FN)
    - pattern: React.useEffect($FN)
  has:
    field: arguments
    has:
      any:
        - kind: arrow_function
        - kind: function_expression
        - kind: identifier
